Olga Petrov  
Moscow, Russia | +7 495 123 4567 | olga.petrov@email.com  

**Professional Experience / Work History**  
**VitalPlay Technologies** | Senior Game Developer (2023–present)  
Led the development of *VitalRehab*, a gamified physiotherapy platform, integrating motion capture analytics to improve user engagement by 25% within six months. Designed cross-platform networking systems for multiplayer sessions, enabling real-time collaboration among 50+ users in clinical trials. Mentored two junior developers, resulting in a 40% reduction in bug resolution time.  

**VitalPlay Technologies** | Lead Game Systems Designer (2022–2023)  
Architected the core physics engine for *VitalBalance*, a device that uses VR to monitor posture in elderly patients. Collaborated with medical advisors to align game mechanics with therapeutic goals, achieving a 30% improvement in patient compliance. Spearheaded REST API integration between hardware sensors and the game engine, reducing data latency by 15%.  

**MediGame Labs** | Junior Game Engineer (2020–2022)  
Contributed to *MediMoto*, a rehabilitation app using 3D graphics (OpenGL) to simulate movement exercises. Implemented collision detection systems that improved accuracy in tracking patient motions by 20%. Developed modular tools for rapid prototyping, cutting development cycles by 2 weeks per feature.  

**PixelForge Studios** | Game Developer Intern (2019–2020)  
Assisted in creating a puzzle game for mental health therapy, focusing on user interface design. Collaborated on a Unity project that later became a finalist in the Global Healthtech Game Awards.  

**Education**  
**Bachelor of Science in Game Development** | Moscow State University (2016–2020)  
Focused on interactive systems and human-computer interaction, with a thesis on gamification in therapeutic contexts.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
- **Unreal Engine**: Engineered core systems for *VitalRehab*, including VR navigation and haptic feedback integration. Mentored team on best practices for multi-threaded asset loading.  
- **Game Physics**: Designed physics-based movement systems for *VitalBalance*, ensuring realistic motion tracking for clinical accuracy.  
- **Game Networking**: Developed peer-to-peer synchronization for multiplayer sessions in *VitalRehab*, supporting 50+ concurrent users without latency spikes.  
- **REST API Design**: Built APIs to connect hardware sensors with game systems at MediGame Labs, enabling real-time data exchange.  
- **Unity**: Maintained legacy systems for *MediMoto*, optimizing performance for low-end devices.  
- **3D Graphics (OpenGL)**: Implemented rendering pipelines for motion-tracking exercises in *MediMoto*, improving frame rates by 18%.  
- **Python**: Automated testing scripts for Unity projects, reducing manual testing hours by 10%.

- *TherapyQuest* (2021): Open-source VR tool for cognitive therapy, using Unreal Engine to simulate memory challenges.  
- *SensorSync* (2022): Side project integrating Arduino sensors with Unity to monitor patient movement during rehab.
